name: ios-swift
description: Swift + SwiftUI + Swift Concurrency + Swift Package Manager. An iOS-only native app.

notes.platformBoundary: Tokens go in the Keychain — UserDefaults is plaintext. Without permission usage descriptions (NS…UsageDescription in Info.plist) the app is rejected in review or crashes at runtime
notes.toolchain: Commands depend on the Xcode scheme name, so the preset does not set them — init confirms `xcodebuild -scheme <scheme>` with the user
notes.release: Store review is the only release path. Old app versions keep running, so API version negotiation is required
